name: Travel Wallet
instruction: Create a 3D model of a travel wallet. It should be rectangular and have a zip around closure.

Shape accuracy: The wallet has a rectangular shape.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The length and width of the wallet are proportionate to its intended use.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The wallet maintains a flat profile when closed.
The zipper runs along the perimeter of the wallet.
Object distance and contact: The zipper is positioned correctly along the edges of the wallet.
There are no gaps in the closure when the wallet is zipped.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The rectangular shape and zip around closure are implemented as instructed.
